summary: Iter22 — Admin Affiliate detail modal bonification. Tested backend PUT /api/admin/affiliates/{id} with new extended fields (name, payout_address, payout_currency, coupon_percent, admin_notes) and full frontend edit flow. All 5 backend pytest tests PASS. Frontend modal enrichment works end-to-end: header (name+email+code), copy-code button (clipboard verified = 'FN7HGWNX'), resend-invite button (visible only for 'invited' status, absent on 'active'), edit form with 5 EditField testids + 2 textareas all present, save persists and reloads modal with Public Promo %=12%, Affiliate Payout Settings block (new-crypto-addr / USDC), Internal Admin Notes block with warning border. Toast 'Updated' shown after save. Toast 'Invite resent' shown when resending. Data rolled back to neutral values after tests.

rca of the issue: During validation of the modal edit flow, data-testid='affiliate-edit-toggle' timed out. RCA: ActBtn was defined as `function ActBtn({ onClick, children })` — it destructured only onClick and children and dropped every other prop (including data-testid). Fix: `function ActBtn({ onClick, children, ...rest })` and spread {...rest} on the underlying <button>. Verified fix: edit-toggle now clickable, resend-invite testid also reaches DOM on the invited affiliate row.
